parts.text: Tom's ship can travel at 10 miles per hour.
He is sailing from 1 to 4 PM.
During his journey, he spots a group of dolphins swimming at a speed of 5 mph, but this doesn't affect his speed.
He then travels back at a rate of 6 mph, even though a nearby speedboat is moving at 20 mph.
How long does it take him to get back?

parts.text: The Doubtfire sisters are driving home with 5 kittens adopted from the local animal shelter when their mother calls to inform them that their two house cats have just had kittens.
She says that Patchy, the first cat, has had twice the number of adopted kittens, while Trixie, the other cat, has had 10.
How many kittens does the Doubtfire family now have?
